title: Dock Radio / listening desk

provenance.content: Original fictional Vitris teaching brief and copy; no customer claims.
provenance.media: Original inline cassette SVG and locally synthesized eight-second sine-wave sequence. No external samples, music or photographs.
provenance.rights: Original Vitris teaching material; factual adaptation required for customer use.

storyboard.mobile: Windows stack with complete native audio controls; guide/credits follow listening content. No draggable chrome or tiny emulated controls required.

visualReview.scope: desktop/mobile homepage/interior full-page contact-sheet review; batch comparison
visualReview.assessment: All four full-page views inspected and latest stable-capture contact sheet re-inspected. Native audio desk/player window and guide have different chrome from other studies; narrow stacks player, guide, taskbar and complete teaching footer. Interior player precedes recording notes. Initial Chromium full-page capture changed document height and clipped the narrow home footer; two-capture stabilization now retains complete footer with geometry recorded. Native CUA desktop play and narrow interior play/pause exercised (2026-10-05T18:30:54.837Z, 18:31:30.723Z, 18:31:36.473Z); narrow pause returned paused true at 5.667883 seconds of 8. No audible-quality, seek or volume exercise claimed. Audio is original synthesized tone study; no third-party sample or broadcast.
